$comment: End-to-end scenarios for the realtime voice conversation. Both ends run the same scenarios against a scripted fake Gemini Live server (closed loop: it listens to the uplink PCM) with a debug-only injected PCM source instead of the microphone. No real API key. Corpus WAVs are generated by scripts/voice-e2e-corpus.mjs from the clips below (16 kHz mono s16, 300 ms lead silence).

segments: 我下周要去上海出差三天，帮我想一想除了工作之外，晚上可以去哪些地方走走，最好离地铁站近一点
What is the weather like today
I am flying to Chicago next week for three days of meetings, so could you suggest a few places to visit in the evenings that are close to a train station
Wait, let us change the topic

fakeServer.transcript: one serverContent.inputTranscription per clip segment, text = that segment, sent when the segment's speech ends (gap >= fragmentGapMs); ACTIVITY_END at turn end

reply.audio: 24 kHz PCM16, 440 Hz tone at -30 dBFS, 100 ms chunks on the real clock, then turnComplete
reply.typedText: realtimeInput / clientContent text from the app is answered the same way with {transcript} = the typed text

fakeServer.bargeIn: speech start detected while reply audio is still being sent: send serverContent.interrupted=true, stop the reply, start the next turn

failures.network: socket connect throws an IO error (realtime-model.v1 failure_connect_error_network)

fakeTextProvider.model: the end's seeded smoke text model (stands in for DeepSeek: a non-realtime chat model)
records: model id of every text chat request (textRequestModels: a realtime id posted to the text API is red)
fakeTextProvider.dictation: the ≋ voice conversation's speech-to-text is the end's debug injected recognizer returning the clip's segments joined; system TTS is a counting debug speech engine (tts = utterances started)

expectGlossary.counters: textRequests / realtimeSessions / tts / connections are counted from the scenario entry (the value at entry is the baseline and is subtracted); chained scenarios keep the first scenario's baseline
expectGlossary.latestTurnVisible: after the turn lands, the newest assistant bubble is on screen on the chat page without any scroll by the test (the list follows the conversation)
expectGlossary.realtimeSessions: realtime voice sessions started (RealtimeVoiceSession / builder audio() calls)
expectGlossary.tts: system TTS utterances started (counting debug speech engine)
expectGlossary.cascadeEnded / realtimeEnded: the previous voice engine of this conversation is stopped (controller idle / socket closed) before the new engine opens
expectGlossary.switchNotice: the stage status line shows copy key voice_realtime_switched_to with the new model name once (about 1.6 s, realtime-model.v1.json composer engineSwitchMidSession), stage not collapsed ('text' = the text model's display name); same conversation, no second voice surface
expectGlossary.sendEnabled: the conversation's primary entry for its stored model is usable: when the stored model is realtime and the catalog is ready, the composer row is replaced by the voice stage and its orb (iOS voice_conversation_orb_button) is tappable, there is no send / start-voice key to find. Never a disabled key or an error card (Q1 E-719)
expectGlossary.catalogFailedRow: voice catalog fetch failed (LoadFailed) for a conversation whose stored model is a possible realtime id: without any tap, a row above the composer shows copy voice_realtime_catalog_unavailable with the action voice_realtime_action_retry; the primary key is disabled and shows no spinner (E-697: the failure must be visible at once, not hidden behind a tap)
expectGlossary.modelLoading: the stored model is a possible realtime id and the voice catalog has not arrived yet: the primary key is visible in its loading state (disabled, accessibility label = copy voice_realtime_model_loading, the same short text visible), the top bar still names the stored model, no error card and no fallback to another model; when the catalog arrives the voice stage replaces the composer row without any tap (Q1 E-719 amended, E-696)
expectGlossary.delistedBanner: the chat page banner saying the conversation's model is no longer available (delisted / removed); a stored realtime model must never show it while the catalog is loading or after it arrives (mimi on-device blocker, E-692 / E-701)
expectGlossary.micOpened: any voice engine started capturing (realtime uplink ms > 0 or cascade STT started)
expectGlossary.silentNoOp / visibleFeedback: tapping must produce a visible state within 2 s (loading on the voice surface or a failure card with an action); nothing happening is red

layout.homeIdleKeyboardPillCentredUnderOrb: idle stage: the switch-to-typing pill (keyboard glyph + visible label voice_realtime_switch_to_keyboard) has centre X equal to the orb centre X within 2 pt/dp and sits below the orb (pill top > orb bottom) (E-734, design §9.3; replaces the retired keyboard-left-of-orb rule)
layout.stageListBandContinuity: on the chat page with >= 3 bubbles, checked both with the stage idle and in the composer state (right after send, as it is), in light and dark runs (E-736: no bottom backdrop layer, list content fades out by alpha): take a 40 px wide column at x = 4% of the width from the list top to the screen bottom (in the composer state it stops at the top of the first composer control it crosses, e.g. the model-options chip: a control edge is not a seam), median luma per pixel row; adjacent-row |delta| must stay <= 4 (8-bit) everywhere — a visible seam between list and stage is red

scenarios.entry: home, no realtime model selected, disclosure NOT accepted

steps.do: open model picker, pick the gemini-3.8-live realtime row
speak {lang}-long, then 1000 ms after reply audio starts speak {lang}-barge
tap end (no typing entry during a session, E-738), then on the idle stage tap the keyboard pill, type 'typed hello', send

tap back to stage (the typed send opened a playback-only session that is still running, so back to stage resumes capture on the same connection, E-528 / backToStageCases typingOpened -> resumeCapture; no typing entry during a session, E-738)

scenarios.entry: after home_full_flow: open that conversation from the home list

steps.do: tap orb, wait listening, background the app 5 s, foreground

scenarios.entry: after background_keeps_session: end, terminate and relaunch, open the conversation
home, realtime selected, fake server in network failure mode

steps.do: switch fake server to normal, tap retry

scenarios.entry: home, realtime selected, fake server in auth failure mode
chat page of an existing conversation on the text model with 1 user + 1 assistant message (sent by typing), disclosure accepted, voice catalog ready

steps.do: while the ≋ conversation is still active, open model picker from the chat top bar, pick the gemini-3.8-live realtime row

scenarios.entry: after text_to_realtime_midway: same conversation, realtime session still active

steps.do: while the realtime session is active, open model picker from the chat top bar, pick the text model row

scenarios.entry: chat page of an existing text conversation, no voice conversation active

steps.do: open model picker, pick the gemini-3.8-live realtime row; then open it again and pick the text model row

scenarios.entry: chat page of an existing conversation whose model is already gemini-3.8-live (picked in an earlier run), disclosure accepted, voice catalog NOT ready (no cache and the catalog fetch fails; the picker lists no realtime rows then)

steps.do: open the conversation (catalog fetch already failed), wait 1 s, no tap

scenarios.entry: an existing conversation whose stored model is gemini-3.8-live, opened from the home list; run in two variants: catalog 'ready' (cached before launch) and catalog 'late' (no cache, the catalog fetch answers 3 s after the chat page appears)

steps.do: variant 'late' only: wait until the catalog arrives, then 1 s

screenshots: every step saves <scenario>-<NN>-<step>.png (after its expectations are checked or failed) into the run's shots dir, for each locale x appearance
